verdicts.reason: A keeps the brand intact: a large two-line headline, a legible address diamond and date diamond, and a visible city photo. Flaws: the body copy is tiny, the empty diamond-outline pattern is a big dead area, the rule floats detached from the headline, the vertical URL is tiny, and the photo is a cropped small rectangle instead of the diamond collage. B is unusable: the city photo is shrunk to a ~30px thumbnail, the address diamond is isolated in the far right with illegible text, and the date diamond is tiny and jammed against the body copy. The URL is illegible, the rule is stranded, the layout is scattered and the headline has no visual support.
